propositions: Lifecycle intents (bind, confirm, re-key, retire, baseline, comment-identity changes) must be modeled as versioned-only mutations with no independent counter, where each intent.version equals its enclosing Observation.version exactly.

Create-before-link and parent-before-child prerequisites must be encoded as explicit inter-ticket dependencies in TicketPlan; blocked prerequisites defer with reason dependency_deferred and emit no out-of-order mutations.

Selection, filter, mode-cap, and global safety limit decisions must be applied during pre-effect planning before any lifecycle intent or remote effect becomes eligible, with each exclusion tagged by deterministic defer_reason (scope_deferred or safety_aborted).
Ticket-sourced conditions (tombstones, pending/index lag, moved keys, impossible links, partial snapshots, filtered passes) must map to deterministic skipped dispositions with reason recording.
